data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental in 2034 and need gluten-free food options? You are not alone. Whether you have coeliac disease or a gluten sensitivity, enjoying a day on the Mediterranean without worrying about your diet is absolutely possible. This guide covers exactly what to bring, where to shop locally, and how our fleet departing from Puerto Banús can accommodate your needs. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, light snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT — so you can focus on the sun, sea, and safe eating.

What Gluten-Free Food to Bring on Your Marbella Boat Rental

Bringing your own gluten-free food is straightforward and recommended for total peace of mind. Our boats have fridges and coolers, and we can provide extra ice packs on request. Here are practical, heat-friendly ideas:

  • Gluten-free wraps or sandwiches — fill with grilled chicken, hummus, or cheese. Avoid mayo in the heat.
  • Fresh fruit — grapes, berries, melon slices. Easy to eat and hydrating.
  • Nuts and seeds — almonds, cashews, pumpkin seeds. High protein, no mess.
  • Cheese and olives — hard cheeses like Manchego travel well. Pair with gluten-free crackers.
  • Pre-made salads — quinoa, chickpea, or tomato-cucumber. Dress on the side.
  • Gluten-free snacks — rice cakes, corn chips, gluten-free granola bars.

Pack everything in a cool bag with ice packs. Avoid chocolate or anything that melts above 25°C — summer in Marbella averages 28°C.

Where to Buy Gluten-Free Food Near Puerto Banús

You can stock up just before your charter. Two reliable spots:

  • Supercor Puerto Banús — next to the marina, offers a dedicated gluten-free section with bread, pasta, crackers, and snacks. Open daily 9am–10pm.
  • Mercadona (Golden Mile) — a 5-minute drive, stocks Hacendado gluten-free range. Good for fresh produce and pre-made salads.

If you need speciality items, El Corte Inglés in Marbella town has an organic section with gluten-free options. All stores are within 10 minutes of our departure point.

Gluten-Free Options Included in Your Charter

Every booking includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. We can swap standard beer for gluten-free beer — just let us know when you book. Snacks typically include nuts, fresh fruit, and gluten-free crackers. For larger groups, we can arrange gluten-free platters from local delis via WhatsApp (48 hours notice required). Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, including all the above. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 variants) from €4,719 for 4 hours include a free jet ski.

Our Fleet: Boats for Gluten-Free Groups in 2034

We operate 18 boats from Puerto Banús, all with fridges and coolers. Capacities range from 5 to 12 passengers. Popular choices for gluten-free groups:

Tips for a Smooth Gluten-Free Day on the Water

Here are five practical tips for your Marbella boat rental:

  1. Communicate early — tell us about your dietary needs at booking so we can adjust snacks and drinks.
  2. Bring your own cool bag — even though we have fridges, extra ice packs help on hot days.
  3. Pack smart — avoid crumbly foods; use airtight containers to prevent cross-contamination.
  4. Stay hydrated — drink water between gluten-free beers or wine. We provide plenty of water.
  5. Plan your route — our skippers know gluten-free-friendly spots for swimming, like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I bring my own gluten-free food on a Marbella boat rental?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own gluten-free food and drinks aboard any of our boats. We provide a cooler and ice on request to keep your items fresh. Just let us know in advance so we can prepare.

Are the included snacks on the boat gluten-free?

Our standard light snacks include options like nuts, fresh fruit, and gluten-free crackers. We also offer gluten-free beer and wine. If you have specific dietary needs, please inform us when booking so we can tailor the selection.

What gluten-free foods are easy to bring for a boat day in Marbella?

We recommend gluten-free wraps or sandwiches, cheese, olives, hummus with veggie sticks, fresh fruit, and pre-packaged gluten-free snacks. Avoid items that melt easily in the heat. A cool bag with ice packs helps keep everything fresh.

Where can I buy gluten-free food near Puerto Banús before my charter?

Supercor in Puerto Banús has a good selection of gluten-free products, including bread, crackers, and snacks. Mercadona on the Golden Mile also stocks gluten-free items. Both are within a 5-minute drive of the marina.

Do you provide gluten-free meals or catering for groups?

We do not offer full catering, but we can arrange gluten-free platters from local delis upon request. Contact us via WhatsApp at least 48 hours before your charter to discuss options.

What drinks are included, and are they gluten-free?

Included drinks are water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. We offer gluten-free beer options. Let us know your preference when booking so we can stock accordingly.

How do I keep gluten-free food cool on the boat?

All our boats have a fridge and a cooler. We can also provide additional ice packs. For longer charters, bring a portable cool bag with frozen gel packs to keep items chilled.

Can I book a boat for a gluten-free celebration or event?

Absolutely. Whether it's a birthday, anniversary, or corporate event, we can accommodate gluten-free menus. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your requirements and we'll help plan the perfect day.

Book your gluten-free Marbella boat rental today and enjoy a worry-free day on the Mediterranean. Our team is ready to help you plan the perfect charter with your dietary needs in mind.
